descByPlatform.chatgpt: Editorial Grid Collage Fashion Post for Fashion Lookbook Collage Instagram square triptych post. Subject: a three-panel vertical strip collage, each panel 33.3% of a 1:1 square on a collage-bg-bone-white #F2ECE0 canvas, separated by 6px white gutter hairlines. Left panel: female model mid-30s in a terracotta-coat #B65A3A wool overcoat, hand in pocket, looking off-camera against a blush-backdrop #E7BFAE studio paper. Centre panel: male model late 20s in a cream-knit #E8DCC4 cable knit, arms crossed, three-quarter turn. Right panel: female model late 20s in a tailored-charcoal #2E2C2A wool suit, seated posture. Brand wordmark Inter Bold 28pt caps tracking 120 'MAISON LOMA' bottom-centre 50% x 94% y in tailored-charcoal + Cormorant 42pt italic 'autumn lookbook 26' above at 50% x 90% y. Three faces — skin physics applies. Composition: Vertical-thirds grid 1:1 square, each figure Rule of Thirds head at 50% x 36% y, Eye-Level 0°. Camera: Phase One XF IQ4 150MP with 80mm LS at f/6.3, 1/200s, ISO 100, tripod. Lighting: Soft North-Window Diffusion + White Bounce — 6×8ft silk scrim camera-left 60° 2.4m (key), 4×6ft white v-flat camera-right 1.4m (fill), 2×3ft negative flag overhead. Skin: Subsurface Scattering · Visible Pores · Fine Micro-Textures · natural capillary flush. Capture One Warm-14 LUT grain 6 +0.1 EV. References: Jil Sander FW, Toteme lookbook, The Row editorial. Exclude: plastic skin, flat lighting, HDR glow, color cast, logo distortion.
